verdict.rationale: Consensus documents one first-party bulk action: importing thousands of papers into its Library in one click, from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF or RIS. No other bulk operations across many items are evidenced. Search-side aggregation such as Deep Search and the Consensus Meter synthesizes results rather than acting on a user's items. Missing for 10: bulk edit/tag/organize/delete/export across library items, programmatic batch endpoints in the API/MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Import thousands of papers in one click - then search, find gaps, and put your collection to work.
